Coordinator, re root's 03:41Z Orca visual-proof note: no proof images are published anywhere.
- **Proof branch:** the orphan branch cc-sync/xmr-visual-proof was committed locally (~/.claude/worktrees/orca/xmr-visual-proof @ 63f5e9a, holding only the one clean compact-placeholder image). Its git push to the public fork was DENIED by the Claude Code permission classifier ('judged this action dangerous'). It was not retried and not worked around, so the branch does not exist on GitHub.
- **Current screenshots:** the 11 identity-guarded screenshots from the final rendered QA run at 1cac829 (guard passed, each checked by eye) exist only in the gitignored local run directory in the xmr worktree.
- **PR #23312:** the body is accurate as written. Screenshots are to be attached by the author and the checkbox stays unchecked. The PR stays a DRAFT with the full-suite caveats preserved.
- **User gate:** publishing them requires either user approval of the proof-branch push, or the user attaching the local PNGs to the PR (drag and drop). Regenerate with SKIP_BUILD=1 ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1 node tests/tools/cross-machine-recovery-rendered/run.mjs.
